text.hi: इस पाठ में भोला अपना घोड़ा बेचने बाज़ार जाता है। पहले पाठ के नए शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Is paath mein Bhola apna ghoda bechne baazaar jaata hai. Pehle paath ke naye shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: In this lesson Bhola goes to the market to sell his horse. First, let's learn the new words.

steps.meaning: an agreement to buy, sell or exchange something
steps.example: I got a good bargain at the fair.

exampleMeaning.hi: मुझे मेले में अच्छा सौदा मिला।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Mujhe mele mein achha sauda mila.

steps.meaning: to give something and get something else for it

exampleMeaning.hi: चलो अपनी किताबें आपस में बदल लें।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Chalo apni kitaabein aapas mein badal lein.

steps.meaning: to make up your mind about something
steps.example: We decided to go to the zoo.

steps.meaning: a kind and good person, like a spirit from heaven
steps.example: My little sister is an angel.

exampleMeaning.hi: मेरी छोटी बहन एक फ़रिश्ता है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Meri chhoti behen ek farishta hai.

steps.meaning: a tiny magic person in stories

exampleMeaning.hi: परी के चाँदी जैसे पंख थे।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Pari ke chaandi jaise pankh the.

steps.example: The colt ran behind its mother.

exampleMeaning.hi: घोड़े का बच्चा अपनी माँ के पीछे दौड़ा।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Ghode ka bachcha apni maa ke peechhe dauda.

steps.meaning: dry food for cows, horses and other animals
steps.example: The farmer gives fodder to his cows.

exampleMeaning.hi: किसान अपनी गायों को चारा देता है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Kisaan apni gaayon ko chaara deta hai.

instruction.hi: किताब के phrases को उनके मतलब से जोड़ो
instruction.hinglish: Kitaab ke phrases ko unke matlab se jodo
instruction.en: Join the book's phrases to their meanings

pairs.right: a big group of cows or buffaloes
what a hen does to give eggs

text.hi: किताब पूछती है: barter system क्या है? पुराने समय में पैसे नहीं थे। लोग चीज़ के बदले चीज़ देते थे, जैसे अनाज के बदले कपड़ा। इसे barter (वस्तु-विनिमय) कहते हैं। भोला भी यही करता है!
text.hinglish: Kitaab poochhti hai: barter system kya hai? Puraane samay mein paise nahi the. Log cheez ke badle cheez dete the, jaise anaaj ke badle kapda. Ise barter (vastu-vinimay) kehte hain. Bhola bhi yahi karta hai!
text.en: The book asks: what is the barter system? Long ago there was no money. People gave one thing for another, like grain for cloth. This is called barter. Bhola does the same!

steps.question: What is the barter system?
options: exchanging one thing for another thing
steps.answer: exchanging one thing for another thing
steps.modelAnswer: The barter system means exchanging one thing for another thing, without money. It was used in old times, before money.

modelMeaning.hi: बार्टर का मतलब है बिना पैसे के एक चीज़ के बदले दूसरी चीज़ लेना। यह पुराने समय में, पैसे आने से पहले होता था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Barter ka matlab hai bina paise ke ek cheez ke badle doosri cheez lena. Yeh puraane samay mein, paise aane se pehle hota tha.
